name: HadithAPI.com
description: Enterprise-ready authenticated RESTful Hadith service indexing canonical books (Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan Abi Dawud, Jami at-Tirmidhi, Sunan an-Nasa'i, Sunan Ibn Majah, and Mishkat al-Masabih). Supports full-text search across Arabic, English, and Urdu, authenticity grading filters, chapter navigation, and paginated queries.

authentication.description: Free API key obtained instantly from user profile at hadithapi.com.

rateLimit.policy: Tiered rate limits per developer API key.

endpoints.name: Get All Hadith Books
endpoints.description: Retrieves list of available Hadith books with their unique slugs, total hadiths, chapters count, and metadata.

endpoints.name: Get Chapters of a Book
endpoints.description: Retrieves chapter list and breakdown for a specified Hadith book.

endpoints.name: Query / Search Hadiths
endpoints.description: Queries hadiths with rich filters for book, chapter, hadith number, status grade, and multilingual search terms.
